title: 桌上那张照片
summary: Deep night in the study: the aide stands before the desk and 陆崇 sits behind it, while the desk lamp falls on a spread of photographs whose top one shows 苏小满 sweeping with a red cord at her collar.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: deep night in 陆崇's study; 陆崇 (S15) is seated BEHIND the long desk in the FAR half of the vertical frame, 心腹 (S16) stands IN FRONT of the desk in the NEAR half facing him; on the desk between them lie loose photographs and one tea cup at 陆崇's right hand; the near desk edge fills the lower third of frame.
[Shot 1] Extreme close-up, inside the pool of the desk lamp: four or five photographs lie spread on the dark lacquer, the top one showing 苏小满 sweeping with her head down in navy work clothes, a worn red cord hanging out of her collar with its knot frayed.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, slow pull-back: 陆崇 (S15) sits far behind the desk, lean and straight-backed in a dark navy mandarin-collar jacket, both hands resting on the desk; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half facing him, a kraft document folder in one hand.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.800, wide vertical: the long desk lies between the two men, the desk lamp and the floor lamp pooling warm light, tall bookcases along the far wall, a wall clock above them.
soundscape: the soft hum of the desk lamp and the floor lamp, the steady tick of the wall clock, the light rustle of loose photographs on the lacquer, and the low even breathing of the two men.

title: 二房动的手
summary: The aide reports in a flat voice that the second branch made the move, the agreement was just signed, and the first verification meeting falls the day after tomorrow.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) stays seated far behind the desk and 心腹 (S16) stays standing in the near half facing him, the kraft folder in one hand, the photographs and the tea cup still spread on the desk.
[Shot 1] Medium shot in the near half: 心腹 (S16) stands square and still, the folder held down at his side, eyes level on 陆崇.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, closer on 心腹 (S16): he reports flatly in Mandarin, one phrase at a time, without moving his head: [Chinese] 二房那边动的手。协议刚签。 His eyes stay on 陆崇 across the desk.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.800, 心腹 (S16) keeps the same flat tone and lets the last fact land on its own in Mandarin: [Chinese] 后天上午，第一场核实会。 He stands straight and stops there.
soundscape: the aide's flat low voice, the steady tick of the wall clock, the hum of the desk lamp, and a faint creak from the leather sofa by the wall.

title: 指腹划过眉眼
summary: 陆崇 reaches into the pile of photographs, lifts the top one, and strokes his thumb slowly across the face printed in it.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the report is done; 陆崇 (S15) sits far behind the desk with his hands on the desk beside the tea cup, and 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half with the folder at his side; the photographs stay spread on the lacquer.
[Shot 1] Close on the desk top: 陆崇's (S15) right hand, a jade ring on the thumb, crosses into the lamplight and lifts the top photograph clear of the pile.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, extreme close-up: his thumb pad settles on the face in the photograph and strokes slowly from the brow down to the corner of the eye.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, medium shot: 心腹 (S16) watches from the near half, motionless, the folder hanging in his hand; beyond the photograph, 陆崇's (S15) lowered head sits in the far half.
soundscape: the tick of the wall clock, the whisper of a photograph drawn off the pile, the hum of the lamps, and the measured breathing of 陆崇.

title: 半晌说一个像
summary: Eyes down on the photograph, 陆崇 speaks a single word from his throat: how much she looks like her.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) holds the top photograph in his right hand, thumb resting on the face, seated far behind the desk; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half, folder at his side.
[Shot 1] Close on 陆崇's (S15) face, eyes down on the photograph, no expression on it at all.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, 陆崇 (S15) speaks low from his throat, one word only, in Mandarin: [Chinese] 像。 His eyes stay down on the photograph.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.600, hold on his face as the faintest twitch moves his brow; in the soft blur of the near half, 心腹 (S16) stands still.
soundscape: the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the lamps, and the low rasp of 陆崇 drawing breath before the single word.

title: 她妈查到了
summary: The aide steps the folder forward and adds that the girl's mother has finally been traced.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) still holds the photograph with his thumb on the face, seated far behind the desk; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half, the folder in one hand.
[Shot 1] Medium shot in the near half: 心腹 (S16) lifts the folder forward half an inch and keeps his eyes on 陆崇.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, 心腹 (S16) speaks flatly in Mandarin: [Chinese] 陆董，还有一件事。 His hand holds the folder steady in front of him.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.600, 心腹 (S16) adds the single fact in the same flat tone: [Chinese] 她妈，查到了。 He stops there and lets it sit.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, close on 陆崇 (S15): his eyes lift off the photograph by a fraction, his mouth closed.
soundscape: the aide's flat voice, the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the lamps, and the soft shift of the document folder in his hand.

title: 手指停住
summary: 陆崇's thumb freezes on the face in the photograph and he does not move at all.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) is seated far behind the desk with the photograph in his hand and his thumb on the face; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half, folder held at his side.
[Shot 1] Extreme close-up on his hand: the thumb stops dead on the face in the photograph, the finger rigid, the jade ring catching the lamplight.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, close on 陆崇's (S15) face, completely motionless, gaze fixed down on the photograph.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, medium shot: 心腹 (S16) waits in the near half, still, the folder at his side, the wall clock moving above him.
soundscape: the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the lamps, and one held breath in the far half of the room.

title: 叫苏婉，十五年前
summary: The aide names her: 苏婉, who left Jiangcheng fifteen years ago and has not been heard of since.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) sits far behind the desk, the photograph still in his hand with his thumb on the face; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half.
[Shot 1] Medium shot in the near half: 心腹 (S16) draws the folder back to his side and keeps his voice flat.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, close on 心腹 (S16) as he reports in Mandarin: [Chinese] 叫苏婉。十五年前从江城走的。 He offers the facts one after another with no emphasis.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, 心腹 (S16) finishes in the same level tone: [Chinese] 之后，一点音信都没有。 He stands straight and holds there.
soundscape: the aide's flat voice, the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the desk lamp, and the soft stir of air off the tall bookcases.

title: 茶半天没送到嘴边
summary: 陆崇 lifts the tea cup to his chest and lets it hang there, the steam thinning, his gaze carried over it to the photograph.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) sits far behind the desk with the top photograph held in his right hand above the spread on the desk, the tea cup at his right; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half.
[Shot 1] Close on his hands: 陆崇's (S15) right hand lays the photograph back down flat on the spread, then his left hand lifts the tea cup up to chest height and holds it there, the steam thinning above the rim.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, close on 陆崇 (S15): his gaze travels over the top of the cup and settles on the photograph on the desk.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, medium shot: 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half without stirring, the folder at his side, while the cup hangs untouched in the far half.
soundscape: the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the lamps, the faint rise of steam, and the even breathing of the two men.

title: 很轻地念苏婉
summary: After a long pause 陆崇 says her name once, very lightly, the cup still hanging at his chest.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) still holds the tea cup at his chest, seated far behind the desk, the photograph back on the spread in front of him; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half.
[Shot 1] Close on 陆崇's (S15) face, long and unhurried, the room breathing around him.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, 陆崇 (S15) speaks in Mandarin, very light and slow: [Chinese] 苏婉。 He keeps the cup exactly where it is.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.600, hold on him: the cup stays at his chest with the steam gone, and 心腹 (S16) waits in the soft blur of the near half.
soundscape: the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the lamps, and the one quiet word from the far half of the room.

title: 杯底磕出闷响
summary: 陆崇 sets the cup back down; its base meets the wood with a muffled knock and his fingers rest a moment on the rim.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) sits far behind the desk with the tea cup raised at his chest, the photograph lying on the desk; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half.
[Shot 1] Close on his hand: 陆崇 (S15) sets the cup back down on the desk; its base meets the wood with a muffled knock and his fingers rest a moment on the rim.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, close on 陆崇's (S15) face, still looking down at the photograph on the desk.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, medium shot: 心腹 (S16) straightens a little in the near half, the folder held in both hands.
soundscape: a muffled knock of porcelain on wood, the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the lamps, and the low breathing of the two men.

title: 核实会，我去
summary: 陆崇 lifts his eyes off the photograph for the first time and tells the aide he will attend the verification meeting himself.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) sits far behind the desk, the cup back on the desk in front of him and the photograph lying open on the lacquer; 心腹 (S16) stands in the near half.
[Shot 1] Medium shot: 陆崇 (S15) lifts his head clear of the photograph for the first time and looks straight across the desk at 心腹.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, 陆崇 (S15) speaks low and level in Mandarin: [Chinese] 后天上午的核实会。我去。 His back stays straight and his eyes hold on the aide.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, 心腹 (S16) in the near half answers with a single small nod.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, wide vertical: the two men face each other across the long desk, the lamps warm between them.
soundscape: the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the lamps, and 陆崇's low steady voice carrying to the near half of the room.

title: 照片入屉，闷鼓两记
summary: 陆崇 lays the photograph into a drawer and shuts it, the study settles, and two muffled drum hits close the episode.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) sits far behind the desk with his eyes on 心腹 (S16), who stands in the near half; the photograph lies open on the desk.
[Shot 1] Close on the desk: 陆崇 (S15) lifts the photograph and lays it flat into an open drawer at his side.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, his hand slides the drawer shut, then rests on the edge of the desk.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, wide vertical hold: 陆崇 (S15) far behind the desk, 心腹 (S16) in the near half, the desk lamp and the floor lamp pooling warm light and the wall clock ticking above them.
soundscape: the drawer sliding home on its runners, the tick of the wall clock, the hum of the lamps, and the soft settle of the leather chair.
music: Two muffled drum hits, low and spaced, over a sustained dark string bed that fades out.
